expect_edges.note: RESOLVED (LA.34): the unqualified self-call `add(acc, x)` inside `total` is classified in the parser by Dart's lexical scope (locals, then the class's own members, then library scope): `add` is a member of Calc, so it is emitted as a SelfMethod and graph resolve_calls binds it against the enclosing CLASS's methods.
